screening.reason: Exclusion 3: analysis is based entirely on T1-weighted structural brain images (a deep-learning sex-prediction classifier pretrained on UK Biobank, transferred and validated on ABIDE I+II, tested on EU-AIMS/LEAP); no resting-state functional connectivity analysis of ABIDE data is reported.

evidence_quotes: Using a novel deep learning framework trained to predict biological sex based on T1-weighted structural brain images, the authors compared sex prediction model perfor- mance across neurotypical and autistic males and females.
